messages:
maria: heads up — GH advisory flagged multiple Go deps in the serving repo. grpc, golang-jwt, and some net/http usage looks implicated. link: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xxxx-xxxx

ajay: can you paste the CVE IDs? exploitability?

maria: CVEs called out in the scanner: CVE-2026-1122 (grpc DoS via header parsing), CVE-2026-1130 (github.com/golang-jwt/jwt token validation bypass), and CVE-2026-1144 (net/http header smuggling affecting go1.19/1.20). dependabot already opened PRs for grpc and jwt in staging.

kevin: quick triage notes — grpc vuln requires bump to v1.56.2+ (affects certain server options), jwt needs upgrade to v4.4.4 which changes API for ParseWithClaims (minor code updates), net/http is stdlib, patch comes in go1.20.11+ or go1.21.5+.

olivia: is the jwt PR safe to merge? we have a lot of places that call jwt.Parse(token, ...). breaking change risk?

kevin: jwt v4 switches module path for some helpers, but for our usage we only need to adjust ParseWithClaims call signature in auth/middleware. small patch, tests pass locally.

maria: attack surface: public inference API + internal admin endpoints. high-profile customers may be impacted. I recommend emergency patching for Dedicated and Hosted control plane; Private customers we'll communicate plan.

ajay: proposed rollout: 1) pin go.mod to grpc v1.56.3 (latest patched), github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v4.4.4, then run go mod tidy/build images in staging. 2) bump Go toolchain to 1.21.5 in builder images to eliminate net/http issue for new builds. 3) canary deploy to 10% of traffic for 2 hours, monitor errors and latency. 4) full rollout.

maria: agree. owners?

kevin: I'll own grpc + CI builds. tagging @ajay for jwt changes in auth. olivia can coordinate canary and perf dashboards.

olivia: canary checklist — smoke test endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, admin token introspection. Add alert if 5xx rate increases by >1% or 95p latency regresses by >100ms.

maria: also add audit log marker for patched builds (so we can correlate). we should capture KMS key usage spikes in case of replay or re-encryption churn. @sre-bot can we ensure audit retention for 7 days extra during rollout?

sre-bot: noted. Increasing audit retention for inference-control-plane logs by +7d for the next 72h. Will post link to updated retention: https://internal/logs/retention/123

dependabot: automated PRs: #452-grpc-patch, #453-jwt-upgrade. Both pass unit tests; integration tests pending.

ajay: integration matrix — make sure we build with go1.21.5 and run integration against dedicated staging with KV cache warm. Also check third_party clients that vendor jwt in edge cases.

kevin: small code snippet to apply in auth middleware:
```
- token, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(raw, &Claims{}, keyfunc)
+ token, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(raw, &Claims{}, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) { return keyfunc(t) })
```
Notes: explicit typing avoids ambiguous overloads in v4.

maria: timeline: aim for staged merge within 4 hours, staging build + canary same day, full rollout tomorrow morning UTC if no regressions. Communicate to sales/support.

olivia: I will open a short incident-style post in #incidents with timeline + rollback plan and link to PRs.

kevin: rollback plan — if grpc or jwt causes regression, revert to previous module versions and pin go toolchain to prior image and redeploy. Keep previous docker image tags for quick rollback.

maria: going to mark this P1 for the next 12h. please post status updates in this thread when you merge or see anomalous metrics. :eyes:
